semantics.ignore_sources: per-directory .gitignore files from the root down; .git/info/exclude and core.excludesFile are not read; matching is case-sensitive; symlinked .gitignore files are ignored
semantics.tracked_files: ignore rules apply whether or not a file is tracked; the Git index is not read
semantics.complete: Report.complete = skipped == 0 and not truncated; skipped counts unreadable directories, unsupported names, ignore-limit subtrees and depth limits
semantics.policy_filters: .git, hidden names (unless include_hidden), symlinks, special files: reported in Report, not skipped
semantics.order: discovery = directory order; path_then_offset = component-wise byte order via per-directory sort, discovery fallback with a reason when the path cache is full
semantics.sink: root-relative path slices valid only during push; sink errors stop the walk and are returned

exports: zcr_fs_traverse (src/fs/traverse.zig): Caps{defaultBytes, ignorePoolBytes}, Report, Traverser{init, deinit, enumerate (core.EnumerateFn), report}
zcr_fs_traverse.ignore: Pattern, parseLine, wildmatch, Rule, RuleStack{init, deinit, mark, restore, pushFile, isIgnored}
limitations: 200,000-file behaviour not measured on this host; memory independence was shown at 1k and 10k files
tracked-but-ignored files are omitted (differs from git ls-files --cached)
info/exclude, core.excludesFile and core.ignorecase are not applied
wildmatch is byte-wise: ? and brackets match one byte, not one code point
per-directory sort holds the entries of every directory on the current path in the cache
Linux and Intel macOS are cross-compiled only
